split.calibration_pool: previously scored stations, excluding every previously scored station-day
split.validation_pool: stations never scored in prior study

candidates.None_stay_factor: strict same-area priority until exhausted; exploratory extreme

config.partition: recursive median split along longest depot-centered metric-coordinate extent; stop-ID ties; maximum leaf capacity
config.ordering: prefer nearest remaining stop in current area if its directed cost <=stay_factor*globally nearest cost; otherwise globally nearest; start globally nearest from depot
config.calibration_loss: mean over station-day clusters of (Amazon score + abs(known-zone reentry rate minus actual) + abs(log(matrix travel-time ratio to actual)))/3
config.selection: minimum calibration_loss; tie within1e-12 prefer NN then smaller leaf capacity and weaker stay factor
config.validation_primary: cluster mean selected_model_loss minus NN_loss; bootstrap descriptive95 interval; negative improvement
config.supplied_zone_diagnostic: same selected preference with native zone IDs; no actual order as feature; not deployable Ota rule
config.geographic_sensitivity: selected automatic model with coordinate-distance ordering, evaluated on native time matrix; not road-distance validation
config.adoption: only limited candidate under assumed common conditions; final target-operations evidence assessed separately
config.diagnostic_parameter_rule: best_area minimizes the same calibration loss among area candidates, even if NN wins overall; never chosen on holdout
